# use-physics

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse physics set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-physics/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-physics/

- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-physics/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-physics/llms-full.txt. The /sets/use-physics/ aliases serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
